summary.text: Demonstration profile focused on building useful applications, connecting systems and working with the people who use them.

items.text: Harbor Example - Developed web applications with Python and React to support internal operations.
Integrated APIs and data across systems to simplify manual work.
Gathered requirements and supported users to adapt applications to their work.
Prototyped assistants that consult documentation and show the sources used in their answers.
Vocational training in web application development.
